originals.title: Compare a team's play types with the league average
originals.description:
As a coach, I want to compare my team's play types with the same-season league average, so I can see which areas are above or below the wider benchmark.

Use case: Compare Play Types with League Average (A32dd7c488267720).

Acceptance criteria:

  • Use one team, season and regular-season side consistently for team and league values.

  • Calculate league PPP from summed points and possessions for each play type, not an unweighted mean of team percentages.

  • Show team PPP, league PPP, their difference and sample counts; state whether the selected team is included in the league benchmark.

  • Show missing categories as unavailable instead of zero; keep source version and labels visible.

  • Verify filters, request states, role access and linked tests before deployment and completion.

Planned for Beta; due 2026-11-09.

originals.title: Track a team's play-type usage and efficiency across seasons
originals.description:
As a coach, I want to compare a team's play-type usage and efficiency across available seasons, so I can see how its style has changed.

Use case: Track Play-Type Trends Across Seasons (A3fb2384b7572cf4).

Acceptance criteria:

  • Select one team and one or more play types across the available seasons.

  • Use consistent regular-season definitions and show possession counts, usage and PPP for each season.

  • Keep seasons in chronological order and mark missing seasons as gaps, not zero results.

  • Do not connect these season summaries to last 5/10/15-game form or claim they forecast future performance.

  • Verify chart/table parity, sample warnings, request states and role access, then publish the linked model and tests.

Planned for Beta; due 2026-11-16.

originals.title: Compare two teams' season-long play-type profiles
originals.description:
As a coach, I want to compare two teams' play-type profiles side by side, so I can prepare for their different styles.

Use case: Compare Head-to-Head Play-Type Profiles (A3f15ca90f30ea8e).

Acceptance criteria:

  • Select two distinct teams and one available regular season.

  • Align play types and show each team's offensive usage, PPP and possession counts using the same denominators.

  • Label the comparison as season-long profiles, not statistics from direct games between those teams.

  • Keep missing categories separate from zero and use consistent units/scales on both sides.

  • Verify swap behavior, source totals, request states and role access; publish tests and the VP model.

Planned for Final; due 2026-11-30.

originals.title: Show independent possession outcome rates by play type
originals.description:
As a coach, I want to see scoring, turnover and foul-related possession rates for each play type, so I can understand how possessions tend to finish.

Use case: View Possession Outcome Rates (A303ecfb1b5e7ad9).

Acceptance criteria:

  • Select a team and season and show regular-season play-type possession counts with scoring, turnover, free-throw, shooting-foul and and-one rates where supported by the source.

  • Treat the rates as independent, potentially overlapping measures. Do not stack or normalize them into an exclusive100% outcome chart.

  • Use the correct possession weighting and state the rounded-source limitation; flag impossible source rates instead of silently clamping or treating them as valid.

  • Show plain definitions, missing values and small-sample limitations.

  • Verify source parity, boundary/invalid data, request states and role access before publishing the model and app.

Planned for Final; due 2026-12-07.
